## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related Issue

Link issue number, for example: Closes #123

## Change Type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Chore

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Added/updated fixtures or tests where relevant

## Screenshots or Outputs

Include screenshots for UI changes or sample outputs for data/export changes.

## Data and License Checks (if applicable)

- [ ] Source attribution added
- [ ] License compatibility checked
- [ ] Metadata updated

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project style
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed
- [ ] No unrelated changes included
